text: Governor Bolt boosts spending in Nordland: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Governor Bolt raises school spending in Nordland from 70 to 76 out of 100.
Governor Bolt goes public: Zara offered a bribe for a higher import tax. Zara gets a fine.
Governor Bolt keeps Nordland's spending steady this year.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Governor Bolt raises help for the poor in Nordland from 12% to 14% of typical pay.
Governor Bolt goes public: Faye offered a bribe for a business tax cut. Faye gets a fine.
Governor Bolt loses the election in Nordland with 46% of the vote.
Governor Bolt accepts defeat in Nordland and hands over power.
Governor Kai replaces Bolt in Nordland after the election.
